text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to the park
to take a breather, but……

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The trick to running fast, the trick... But
I've never really thought about stuff like that when I run...

I spotted Silence Suzuka, pacing in
left-handed circles as she pondered.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! I-I'm so sorry.
Was I blocking the path—... Oh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here I go again, lost in thought
and wandering all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: To think I've worried this much and still can't think of anything...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, that junior girl will definitely be sad.
...Ah, what should I do?
choice_data_list: Maybe the secret is hidden in those counter-clockwise turns.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Run as a pace partner? Ah, right……

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If words can't convey it,
then you just have to experience it for yourself...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
.
I'll go ask someone to run a tandem gallop with me right away.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's a trick to this counterclockwise turn?
I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I never really thought about it myself.
But... before I know it, I'm always doing it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll convey the message for now. ...I hope it helps.
